Contract ProcessSaleService::enterItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		item: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode),
		currentSaleLine: SalesLineItem,
		bool: Boolean = if item.StockNumber>0 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		Item.allInstance()->includes(item) and
		item.StockNumber>0
	postcondition:
		let currentSaleLine: SalesLineItem in
		currentSaleLine.oclIsNew() and
		SalesLineItem.allInstance()->includes(currentSaleLine) and
		currentSale.ContainedSalesLine->includes(currentSaleLine) and
		currentSaleLine.BelongedSale = currentSale and
		currentSaleLine.Quantity = quantity and
		item.StockNumber = item.StockNumber-quantity and
		currentSaleLine.Subamount = item.Price*quantity and
		result = bool
}
